name: Advanced Books
description: Advanced comic, manga, magazine and book features for Jellyfin 12, including Komga-compatible One-Shots and a localized Advanced Reader.
overview: Advanced comic, manga, magazine and book reader for Jellyfin 12.

versions.changelog:
- Harden final reading-position persistence on tab/app backgrounding and page exit with authenticated keepalive progress saves.
- Mark the newest queued reading position for keepalive delivery when an earlier progress request is still in flight.
- Keep two-way page and played-state interoperability with Jellyfin's built-in ComicsPlayer.
- Retain complete Advanced Reader replacement across detail, Home/Library, list, remote and context-menu actions.
- Include the Reader UI, zoom/pinch, page-position and Catalog icon improvements from the independently reviewed v0.16.1 line.
- Expand lifecycle, integration, release and embedded-reader regression validation.

- Complete native Advanced Reader replacement across detail, Home/Library, list, command and context-menu actions.
- Share page progress and played state with Jellyfin's built-in ComicsPlayer using the same UserItemData playback ticks.
- Fix the standalone Advanced Reader button after the native-integration refactor and add direct API regression guards.
- Improve Reader Settings/Help, interaction-aware auto-hide and the optional page-position display.
- Fix Fit Screen/Width focal zoom, pinch release jumps and unreachable pan space on desktop and mobile.
- Refresh the Jellyfin plugin catalog icon with the Advanced Books purple/blue open-book identity.

- Add browser/mobile Back handling and optional Jellyfin Resume/Start-over integration.
- Add focal pinch, Ctrl+wheel and double-tap zoom with one-finger pan after zoom.
- Add Komga-style left/right paged and top/bottom Vertical/Webtoon navigation.
- Add smooth directional page transitions and reduced-motion-aware scrolling.
- Add desktop grab-to-pan/scroll and centered SVG page-navigation icons.
- Add compact two-stage bottom navigation and updated six-language interaction help.

- Add a per-user Reader language override while keeping automatic Jellyfin/browser detection.
- Reorganize Reader Settings into collapsible Reading, Appearance, Behavior, Metadata and Language sections.
- Replace ping-pong metadata scrolling with one-way motion and an invisible reset.
- Reduce mobile chrome clutter with compact floating controls and a localized overflow menu.
- Improve mobile accessibility, focus handling and UI regression validation.

- Add six-language localization for the Advanced Reader and plugin configuration.
- Follow Jellyfin/browser language automatically with stable localized control identifiers.
- Add repository-owned Catalog icon/banner and Books-category manifest metadata.
- Add repository-first installation/update documentation and localization/catalog validation.

- Fix duplicate images in Continuous/Webtoon caused by overlapping async page loads.
- Enforce one-image-per-page slots with stale-load generation guards.
- Make smart double-page spreads deterministic before rendering.
- Ignore __MACOSX/AppleDouble archive metadata entries and verify served page identity.
- Add configurable reader metadata visibility and optional overflow auto-scroll.

- Show Jellyfin title, authors, series and year in Advanced Reader.
- Fix resume for played books and close-time/in-flight progress save races.
- Add Komga-style smart double-page spreads and persisted reader backgrounds.
- Add optional page transitions, touch gestures and contextual keyboard/gesture help.
- Keep the Core reader below the JavaScript Injector size limit and extend preference migration tests.

- Harden JavaScript Injector startup recovery and validate embedded reader assets before registration.
- Keep Core registration transactional while optional reader bridges fail soft.
- Log the loaded Advanced Books assembly version, informational version and DLL path.
- Validate built DLL reader resources with strict UTF-8 and size checks in CI and Release.

- Fix page-grid thumbnails that could remain permanently unloaded after scrolling.
- Add viewport scanning, watchdog recovery, shared thumbnail caching and bounded fallback loading.
- Improve scrub-preview loading/error containment and use a dedicated Reader launch icon.
- Improve mixed-size Vertical/Webtoon current-page tracking and scroll geometry stability.

- Improve desktop/mobile Reader responsiveness and measured viewport Fit sizing.
- Migrate the legacy Fit Height default to Fit Screen and keep mobile controls square.
- Improve scrub previews, archive metadata caching and thumbnail cache reuse.
- Stabilize Vertical/Webtoon scrolling with directional prefetch and scroll-anchor compensation.
- Isolate two-finger pinch zoom from page pan/scroll movement.

- Fix Advanced Reader integration disappearing after corrupted JavaScript Injector registration.
- Split Core, Progress, Preferences, Navigator and Gestures into bounded independent scripts.
- Remove the legacy combined registration and roll back partial registrations safely.
- Add strict UTF-8/control-character and per-script size validation.

- Improve hidden reader chrome so small pointer jitter no longer reveals controls.
- Add debounced authenticated thumbnail previews to the page scrubber.
- Keep scrub previews pinned during long scrubs.
- Reduce duplicate/stale GitHub Actions work and tighten release triggers.

- Redesign Advanced Reader UI for desktop and mobile.
- Add auto-hiding chrome, a page scrubber, responsive settings sheets and fullscreen support.
- Add Fit/zoom/side-padding/page-gap controls to Vertical Continuous and Webtoon.
- Add Ctrl+wheel zoom, two-finger pinch zoom and desktop drag panning.

- Add dedicated two-finger pinch-to-zoom for paged Advanced Reader modes.
- Suppress accidental page turns during pinch and persist the committed zoom through existing Reader controls.
